name: Transaction Details 161
definition: Specifies the details of the transaction.

TradeIdentification.name: Trade Identification
TradeIdentification.definition: Reference assigned to the trade by the investor or the trading party. This reference will be used throughout the trade life cycle to access/update the trade details.

PoolIdentification.name: Pool Identification
PoolIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

CorporateActionEventIdentification.name: Corporate Action Event Identification
CorporateActionEventIdentification.definition: Identification assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a corporate action event.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Collateral Transaction Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.definition: Unique identification identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the triparty-agent's/service-provider's point of view.

ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.name: Client Triparty Collateral Transaction Identification
ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.definition: Unique reference identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the client's point of view.

ClientCollateralInstructionIdentificatio.name: Client Collateral Instruction Identification
ClientCollateralInstructionIdentificatio.definition: Unique identification assigned to the instruction by the client.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralIn.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Collateral Instruction Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralIn.definition: Unique identification assigned to the instruction by the triparty-agent/service-provider.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market in which a trade transaction has been executed.

PlaceOfClearing.name: Place Of Clearing
PlaceOfClearing.definition: Infrastructure which may be a component of a clearing house and which facilitates clearing and settlement for its members by standing between the buyer and the seller. It may net transactions and it substitutes itself as settlement counterparty for each position.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

SettlementQuantity.name: Settlement Quantity
SettlementQuantity.definition: Total quantity of securities to be settled.

PartiallyReleasedQuantity.name: Partially Released Quantity
PartiallyReleasedQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument to be released.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities.

LateDeliveryDate.name: Late Delivery Date
LateDeliveryDate.definition: Date and time after the settlement date specified in the trade, used for pool trades resulting from the original To Be Assigned (TBA) securities.

ExpectedSettlementDate.name: Expected Settlement Date
ExpectedSettlementDate.definition: Date/time at which the sender expects settlement.

ExpectedValueDate.name: Expected Value Date
ExpectedValueDate.definition: For against payment transactions, the value date/time at which the sender expects the settlement amount to be credited or debited.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

AcknowledgedStatusTimeStamp.name: Acknowledged Status Time Stamp
AcknowledgedStatusTimeStamp.definition: Time stamp on when the transaction is acknowledged.

MatchedStatusTimeStamp.name: Matched Status Time Stamp
MatchedStatusTimeStamp.definition: Time stamp on when the transaction is matched.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies if the movement on a securities account results from a deliver or a receive instruction.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, for example, against payment.

SettlementParameters.name: Settlement Parameters
SettlementParameters.definition: Parameters applied to the settlement of a security transfer.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

Investor.name: Investor
Investor.definition: Party, either an individual or organisation, whose assets are being invested.

QualifiedForeignIntermediary.name: Qualified Foreign Intermediary
QualifiedForeignIntermediary.definition: Foreign financial institution which has been authorised by local authorities to act as account management institution in the country.

SettlementInstructionProcessingAdditiona.name: Settlement Instruction Processing Additional Details
SettlementInstructionProcessingAdditiona.definition: Provides additional settlement processing information which can not be included within the structured fields of the message.

InvestorCountryCodeRule.definition: If Investor is used with a country code, then the country code specifies the nationality of the investor, for example for the settlement of certain securities (that is airlines, defence manufacturers) under the EU legislation.

TwoLegTransactionOpeningClosing1Rule.definition: For settlement of two part transactions (Securities Financing), the opening/initiation and closing/return of the transaction is confirmed by sending the following combination of TransactionIdentificationDetails/SecuritiesMovementType codes and SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType codes:||Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: Repo (REPU)|Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: Repo (REPU)||Reverse Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: ReverseRepo (RVPO)|Reverse Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: ReverseRepo (RVPO)||TriParty Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: TriPartyRepo (TRPO)|TriParty Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: TriPartyRepo (TRPO)||TriParty Reverse Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: TriPartyReverseRepo (TRVO)|TriParty Reverse Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: TriPartyReverseRepo (TRVO)||Securities Lending Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SecuritiesLending (SECL)|Securities Lending Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SecuritiesLending (SECL)||Securities Borrowing Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SecuritiesBorrowing (SECB)|Securities Borrowing Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SecuritiesBorrowing (SECB).

TwoLegTransactionOpeningClosing2Rule.definition: For settlement of two part transactions (buy-sell back, sell buy-back, collateral in and out), the opening/initiation and closing/return of the transaction is identified by the providing of the following combination of SecuritiesMovementType codes and SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType codes:|||Sell-Buy Back: Sell|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SellBuyBack (SBBK)|Sell-Buy Back: Buy Back|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SellBuyBack (SBBK)||Buy-Sell Back: Buy|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: BuySellBack (BSBK)|Buy-Sell Back: Sell Back|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: BuySellBack (BSBK)||Collateral (giver) Out Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralOut (COLO)|Collateral (giver) Out Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralOut (COLO)||Collateral (taker) In Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralIn (COLI)|Collateral (taker) In Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralIn (COLI).

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Ru.definition: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
